newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: BASS RAISES STAKE IN CZECH -AGENCY.
newsitem.headline: BASS RAISES STAKE IN CZECH -AGENCY.

text.p: British brewer Bass Plc has raised its stake in Czech brewer Pivovar Radegast a.s., buying a 9.97 percent stake from Raifiessen Capital and Investment Praha, the CTK news agency reported on Tuesday.
CTK, which quoted un-named sources, said that Bass now controlled 29.97 percent of the north Moravian brewer.
Officials from all three firms said they were not able to immediately comment on the report. Bass, however, has said several times that it would like increase its stake in Radegast.
